?Court No. - 74
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 58434 of 2022
Applicant :- Amit Kumar Pal @ Sonu Pal

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Manvendra Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.

Heard Sri Manvendra Singh, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Varun Kumar Agnihotri,
learned brief holder for the State.
The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 121 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station- Dhata, District- Fatehpur, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

F.I.R. for the present case was lodged against applicant and three others and according to the F.I.R.
marriage of the daughter of informant was performed with the elder brother of the applicant and after marriage, applicant and his elder brother and his other family members demanded dowry and in want of dowry they used to torture the daughter of the informant and on 9.8.2022 the mother-in-law of the deceased, administered some poisonous substance to her through food and due to that she died at about 3 p.m.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits entire allegations made against the applicant is totally false and frivolous and applicant has been made accused in the present matter only due to the reason that he was dever of the deceased.

He further submits that on the basis of general allegations applicant has been roped in the present matter along with husband and mother in law and other family members of the husband and there is specific allegation against Amit Kumar Pal @ Sonu Pal vs State Of U.P. on 18 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55264512/
1 mother-in-law in the F.I.R. that she administered poison in the food of victim due to that she died.

sentences.text: He further submits that actually some dispute arose between husband and wife and due to that reason she, i.e. wife, committed suicide by consuming some poisonous substance.

He further submits that father-in-law Ram Bhawan was also nominated as an accused and he has been released on bail by coordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 10.2.2023 passed passed in Crl. Misc. Bail Application No. 58548 of 2022.

sentences.text:
He placed the bail order of co-accused Ram Bhawan,
father-in-law during course of argument which is taken on record and marked as 'A'.
He further submits that the applicant is dever of the deceased, therefore, his case is even on better footing than co-accused Ram Bhawan who was father-in-law.
He next submits that the applicant in the present matter is in jail since 11.8.2022 i.e. for last about more than eight months.

Per contra, learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the applicant is younger brother of the husband of the deceased and he also tortured the deceased along with other co-accused persons for want of dowry but could not dispute the fact that only general allegation has been made against the applicant and co-accused Ram Bhawan, father-in-law has already been released on bail by Co-ordinate Bench of this court.
I have heard both the parties and perused the record of the case.
Applicant is dever of deceased and it appears that deceased died due to the consumption of Aluminium Phosphide.
The chemical analyst report was produced by learned A.G.A. during the course of argument.

From the F.I.R. and other material available on record it appears that on the basis of general allegations applicant has been made accused in the present matter along with husband and other family members and co-accused Ram Bhawan, the father-in-law has already been released on bail,
therefore, in my view, the applicant is also entitled to be released on bail.
Therefore, from the discussion made above, in my view applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant- Amit Kumar Pal & Sonu Pal be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from Amit Kumar Pal @ Sonu Pal vs State Of U.P. on 18 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55264512/

(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.
